projectDescription: An open-source Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android devices that runs all versions from rd-132211 through 1.21 snapshots, with support for Forge, Fabric, Quilt, and OptiFine mod loaders.
keyFeatures: Runs Minecraft: Java Edition on Android (ARM32, ARM64, x86, x86_64)
Supports Minecraft versions from rd-132211 through 1.21 snapshots
Integrated mod loader support for Forge, Fabric, Quilt, and OptiFine
Modpack installation via Modrinth, CurseForge, and Technic
Fully customizable touch controls with a visual editor
Multiple rendering backends: OpenGL ES 2, OpenGL ES 3, Vulkan (Zink)
Microsoft (Xbox Live) and local account authentication
Per-profile game directory, JRE, renderer, and control layout
publicApiSurface: LauncherPreferences — all PREF_* settings constants and loadPreferences(Context)
MinecraftAccount — account model: load(), save(), parse(), isLocal(), isDemo()
MinecraftProfile — launcher profile model with lastVersionId, gameDir, javaArgs, pojavRendererName, controlFile
CustomControls — control layout model: ControlData, ControlDrawerData, ControlJoystickData
MultiRTUtils — runtime management: getRuntimes(), installRuntimeNamed(), getExactJreName(), getNearestJreName()
Tools — core utilities: DIR_GAME_HOME, DIR_GAME_NEW, CTRLMAP_PATH, CTRLDEF_FILE, MULTIRT_HOME
ControlData special buttons: SPECIALBTN_KEYBOARD, SPECIALBTN_MOUSEPRI, SPECIALBTN_VIRTUALMOUSE, etc.
Renderer keys: opengles2, opengles3, vulkan_zink, opengles3_virgl
